rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for valuing someone or something deeply and holding it dear.

example.traditional: 我真係好珍惜呢段友誼。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 zan1 sik1 ni1 dyun6 jau5 ji4

rows.note: Use this colloquial choice when cherishing a person or animal through affection, tenderness, and loving care.

example.english: I cherish the cat at home most.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 sik1 uk1 kei2 go2 zek3 maau1

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on protecting or treating someone or something carefully rather than simply expressing love.

example.english: We should cherish public property and not damage it.
example.traditional: 我哋要愛惜啲公物，唔好整爛。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 oi3 sik1 di1 gung1 mat6 m4 hou2 zing2 laan6
